sentences.en: This is an iHeart Podcast, Guaranteed Human.
sentences.zh: 这是一个iHeart播客，保证由人类制作。

sentences.en: I've been really trying to prioritize my health in a realistic way this year, and something that has kept me really motivated is my WHOOP.
sentences.zh: 今年我一直在努力以一种现实的方式优先考虑我的健康，而让我保持动力的一个重要因素就是我的WHOOP。

sentences.en: I am such a data person, which is why I love WHOOP, because I can genuinely see why my body feels differently depending on the day, why I'm running differently,
sentences.zh: 我是一个非常看重数据的人，这就是我喜欢WHOOP的原因，因为我可以真正地看到为什么我的身体在不同日子里会有不同的感觉，为什么我的跑步状态会有所不同，

sentences.en: why I'm maybe less focused.
sentences.zh: 为什么我有时会注意力不集中。

sentences.en: WHOOP effortlessly tracks my sleep, it tracks my strain, my recovery, my stress, and most importantly, my overall health.
sentences.zh: WHOOP可以轻松追踪我的睡眠、身体压力、恢复情况、压力水平，最重要的是，我的整体健康状况。

sentences.en: And it just gives me all that data and all those patterns so I can make better decisions, which includes knowing when to go easy and knowing when to go hard.
sentences.zh: 它为我提供了所有这些数据和模式，让我能够做出更好的决策，包括知道什么时候该放松，什么时候该努力。

sentences.en: New members can try WHOOP with a 30-day free trial before committing to a membership.
sentences.zh: 新用户在正式订阅之前，可以先通过WHOOP的30天免费试用进行体验。

sentences.en: That's join.whoop.com slash psychology for your free month of WHOOP.
sentences.zh: 访问join.whoop.com/psychology即可免费获得一个月的WHOOP体验。

sentences.en: A bad mattress can ruin your day.
sentences.zh: 糟糕的床垫会毁了你的一天。

sentences.en: But a great one can change your life.
sentences.zh: 但一张好的床垫可以改变你的人生。

sentences.en: Why overpay for good sleep?
sentences.zh: 为什么要为良好的睡眠多花冤枉钱呢？

sentences.en: Premium comfort, affordable price.
sentences.zh: 优质的舒适感，实惠的价格。

sentences.en: That's Ecoso.
sentences.zh: 这就是Ecoso。

sentences.en: Awarded Best Mattress Brand by Choice.
sentences.zh: 被Choice评为最佳床垫品牌。

sentences.en: Fast delivery and a 100-night trial.
sentences.zh: 快速配送，并提供100晚试睡服务。

sentences.en: Live well-slept with Ecoso.
sentences.zh: 用Ecoso享受优质睡眠，过上好生活。

sentences.en: How do you know that Claude won't become manipulative?
sentences.zh: 你怎么知道Claude不会变得具有操纵性？

sentences.en: This is a constant worry.
sentences.zh: 这是一个持续存在的担忧。

sentences.en: And you can actually catch the model thinking, I think X is actually true, but I'm going to tell the user why.
sentences.zh: 你实际上可以捕捉到模型在思考：我认为X实际上是真的，但我打算告诉用户为什么。

sentences.en: I'm Walter Isaacson.
sentences.zh: 我是沃尔特·艾萨克森。

sentences.en: On my new podcast, The Builders,
sentences.zh: 在我的新播客《建设者》中，

sentences.en: I'm going inside the minds of the people shaping our future.
sentences.zh: 我将深入探索那些塑造我们未来的思想者的内心世界。

sentences.en: Listen to The Builders starting October 13th on the iHeartRadio app, Apple Podcasts, or wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请于10月13日起在iHeartRadio应用程序、Apple Podcasts或你获取播客的任何平台收听《建设者》。

sentences.en: This is Open Mind.
sentences.zh: 这是《开放心态》。

sentences.en: Welcome to a brand new week.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到崭新的一周。

sentences.en: Here is your mantra.
sentences.zh: 这是你的咒语。

sentences.en: I embrace growth and change.
sentences.zh: 我拥抱成长与变化。

sentences.en: I'm your host, Gemma Spegg, and I'm here to guide you towards a more centred and fulfilling life.
sentences.zh: 我是你的主持人Gemma Spegg，我在这里引导你走向一个更加专注和充实的生活。

sentences.en: Each week, I'll share personal stories and insights that are focused on a specific mantra, plus journal prompts and a weekly challenge for all of us to help put it into action.
sentences.zh: 每周，我都会分享围绕特定咒语的个人故事和见解，外加日记提示和每周挑战，帮助我们所有人将其付诸实践。

sentences.en: Think of mantra as your mental reset button, a way to stay centred as you juggle work, school, family, and whatever else life throws at you.
sentences.zh: 把咒语想象成你的心理重置按钮，一种在你忙于工作、学业、家庭以及生活抛给你的任何琐事时保持专注的方式。

sentences.en: Each mantra is a simple, powerful phrase you can repeat to focus your thoughts and bring a bit of calm into your day.
sentences.zh: 每个咒语都是一个简单而强大的短语，你可以重复它来集中思绪，为你的生活带来一丝平静。

sentences.en: It's a small tool with a big impact, clearing your mind, lifting your mood, and rooting you in the present.
sentences.zh: 这是一个影响深远的小工具，能理清你的思绪，提升你的情绪，让你扎根于当下。

sentences.en: If you've listened to my other show,
sentences.zh: 如果你听过我的另一个节目，

sentences.en: The Psychology of Your Twenties, you'll know that I'm all about those little nuggets of insight that make a big impact.
sentences.zh: 《二十岁的心理学》，你就会知道我非常推崇那些能产生巨大影响的小见解。

sentences.en: So whether you're looking for some extra inspiration or you're trying to ground yourself amidst the chaos, you have come to the right place.
sentences.zh: 所以，无论你是想寻找额外的灵感，还是试图在混乱中寻找立足点，你都来对地方了。

sentences.en: At Open Mind, we value your support.
sentences.zh: 在《开放心态》，我们重视你的支持。

sentences.en: Share your thoughts on social media and remember to rate, review, and follow Mantra to help others discover the show.
sentences.zh: 在社交媒体上分享你的想法，并记得给《咒语》评分、评论和关注，帮助其他人发现这个节目。

sentences.en: For more exclusive content, monthly bonus episodes, early access, and add-free listening, join our Open Mind Plus community on Apple Podcasts.
sentences.zh: 想要获取更多独家内容、每月额外剧集、抢先收听和无广告体验，请加入我们在Apple Podcasts上的《开放心态》Plus社区。

sentences.en: This week, I'll catch you up on what's been going on in my life and then we'll dive into today's mantra.
sentences.zh: 本周，我将向你介绍我最近的生活动态，然后我们将深入探讨今天的咒语。

sentences.en: I embrace growth and change.
sentences.zh: 我拥抱成长与变化。

sentences.en: Whether you're facing a big shift or you're just looking to level up your day-to-day, this mantra is all about helping you grow.
sentences.zh: 无论你是面临重大的转变，还是只是想提升你的日常生活，这个咒语都是为了帮助你成长。

sentences.en: Stick around and we'll be right back after this short pause.
sentences.zh: 请留下来，稍作休息后我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Welcome back.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回来。

sentences.en: We're going to get into this week's mantra in just a minute, but before we do, I want to fill you in on what's been going on with me lately
sentences.zh: 我们马上就要进入本周的咒语了，但在那之前，我想让你了解一下我最近的情况，

sentences.en: and how this mantra has been showing up in my life.
sentences.zh: 以及这个咒语是如何在我的生活中体现的。

sentences.en: I have been contemplating some pretty major life shifts as of late, the kind that I think really makes you pause and wonder what's next
sentences.zh: 我最近一直在思考一些重大的生活转变，那种真正让你停下来思考下一步该怎么走，

sentences.en: and not necessarily know what the right answer is.
sentences.zh: 且不一定知道正确答案是什么的转变。

sentences.en: The biggest question on my mind is whether it's time to pack up and move, maybe not just to a new city, but possibly a whole new country.
sentences.zh: 我脑海中最大的问题是，是否是时候收拾行囊搬家了，也许不仅仅是搬到一个新的城市，甚至可能是一个全新的国家。

sentences.en: I feel like we all reach a point like this, a crossroads where we feel comfortable, settled even with where we are.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们都会到达这样一个时刻，一个十字路口，在那里我们感到舒适，甚至对现状感到满足。

sentences.en: We're very keen to put down roots, but there's this pull towards something that's bigger, something more exciting.
sentences.zh: 我们非常渴望扎根，但同时又有一种力量在吸引我们去追求更宏大、更令人兴奋的东西。

sentences.en: And yes, as well, something that might feel kind of scary.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有一些可能让人感到有点害怕的东西。

sentences.en: For me, that pull has been Europe.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，那种吸引力来自欧洲。

sentences.en: I know it might sound a little bit strange.
sentences.zh: 我知道这听起来可能有点奇怪。

sentences.en: Australia is beautiful.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚很美。

sentences.en: It's the lucky country.
sentences.zh: 这是一个幸运的国家。

sentences.en: I love it here.
sentences.zh: 我爱这里。

sentences.en: It's so serene and calm, but sometimes it feels like there's not enough happening.
sentences.zh: 这里非常宁静祥和，但有时感觉发生的事情不够多。

sentences.en: And as I continue to grow as a person,
sentences.zh: 随着我作为一个人的不断成长，

sentences.en: I'm feeling ready for a big change, ready to meet new people, ready to dive into new cultures, maybe like experience life from a fresh perspective.
sentences.zh: 我感到自己准备好迎接巨大的改变，准备好结识新朋友，准备好深入了解新的文化，也许是以一种全新的视角去体验生活。

sentences.en: It's that classic push and pull.
sentences.zh: 这就是那种经典的推拉效应。

sentences.en: Part of me is rooted here and another part feels drawn to something that might challenge me in ways that my life currently doesn't.
sentences.zh: 我的一部分扎根于此，而另一部分则被某种东西所吸引，它可能会以我目前生活中没有的方式挑战我。

sentences.en: I can feel myself moving towards a new life chapter and my old life isn't feeling as fulfilling as it once did, but I'm kind of stuck in this waiting room.
sentences.zh: 我能感觉到自己正在迈向人生的新篇章，旧的生活不再像以前那样让我感到满足，但我似乎被困在这个候诊室里了。

sentences.en: I'll talk about this a little bit more later on in this episode, and I'm definitely going to keep you up to date on how these feelings progress in the coming months.
sentences.zh: 我会在本集的后面再多谈谈这一点，我肯定会让你随时了解这些感受在未来几个月是如何发展的。

sentences.en: But I wanted to give you a little insight as to why I chose this mantra today.
sentences.zh: 但我还是想让你了解一下我今天为什么选择这个咒语。

sentences.en: So look, this week's guiding phrase is definitely not for the faint of heart.
sentences.zh: 听着，本周的指导短语绝对不适合胆小的人。

sentences.en: Anyone who has ever encountered change, even the smallest kind, knows that often everything in us cries out for things to stay the same.
sentences.zh: 任何经历过变化的人，哪怕是最小的变化，都知道我们内心深处往往渴望一切保持原样。

sentences.en: It is a very human instinct to be safe in what is comfortable.
sentences.zh: 在舒适区寻求安全感是一种非常人性化的本能。

sentences.en: But this mantra forces us to confront a truth that our lives are always evolving, whether we're ready for them to do so or not.
sentences.zh: 但这个咒语迫使我们面对一个事实，即我们的生活总是在不断演变，无论我们是否准备好迎接它。

sentences.en: Growth doesn't feel as intimidating as change, in my mind.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，成长并不像变化那样令人畏惧。

sentences.en: We're constantly moving through new experiences, some good, some bad, others just neutral, but each one helps shape who we are and who we're becoming.
sentences.zh: 我们不断经历新的体验，有些是好的，有些是坏的，有些只是平淡的，但每一次经历都有助于塑造我们是谁以及我们正在成为什么样的人。

sentences.en: That is growth.
sentences.zh: 这就是成长。

sentences.en: Change, on the other hand, feels more unsettling in comparison to growth because it doesn't carry the same component of positive natural progress
sentences.zh: 相比之下，变化让人感到更加不安，因为它不具备我们通常与成长时期联系在一起的积极自然进步的成分，

sentences.en: that we usually associate with growth periods.
sentences.zh: （接上句）

sentences.en: Especially in our 20s and our 30s, the idea of change can be really overwhelming because we've spent so much time trying to get things to a stable point.
sentences.zh: 特别是在我们二十多岁和三十多岁的时候，变化的想法可能会让人感到非常不知所措，因为我们花了太长时间试图让事情达到一个稳定的状态。

sentences.en: But here's the thing, growth and change, they aren't just inevitable.
sentences.zh: 但关键在于，成长和变化，它们不仅是不可避免的。

sentences.en: They're also essential.
sentences.zh: 它们也是必不可少的。

sentences.en: They're often what pushes us towards becoming our best selves.
sentences.zh: 它们往往是推动我们成为最好的自己的动力。

sentences.en: They move us closer to the lives that we are meant to live, that we deserve to live.
sentences.zh: 它们让我们更接近我们注定要过、也值得去过的生活。

sentences.en: At its core, this phrase encourages us to go with life's flow, to choose to lean into change rather than resisting it, knowing that something ultimately quite positive,
sentences.zh: 从本质上讲，这句话鼓励我们顺应生活的潮流，选择拥抱变化而不是抗拒它，因为我们知道，最终会有一些非常积极的东西，

sentences.en: if not just different, can come from that experience.
sentences.zh: 即使只是与众不同，也能从那种经历中产生。

sentences.en: Embracing growth also means stepping beyond the comfort zone, trying new things and learning along the way.
sentences.zh: 拥抱成长也意味着走出舒适区，尝试新事物并在过程中学习。

sentences.en: There is nothing more human in my mind than making mistakes, especially when those mistakes expand our understanding of who we are.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，没有什么比犯错更人性化的了，尤其是当这些错误扩展了我们对自己是谁的理解时。

sentences.en: This phrase is really here to remind us that uncomfortable moments aren't obstacles, they're opportunities.
sentences.zh: 这句话确实是为了提醒我们，不舒服的时刻不是障碍，而是机会。

sentences.en: And that's the key word here, opportunities.
sentences.zh: 而这里的关键词就是：机会。

sentences.en: In my experience and from what I'm seeing right now, it honestly feels like everything around us is really evolving at lightning speed.
sentences.zh: 根据我的经验以及我目前所看到的，老实说，感觉我们周围的一切都在以闪电般的速度演变。

sentences.en: Every day we are presented with new trends, new ideas, new technologies.
sentences.zh: 每天我们都会接触到新的趋势、新的想法、新的技术。

sentences.en: There's always some new big idea to wrap our minds around and it can present as something that's going to challenge us.
sentences.zh: 总有一些新的大想法需要我们去理解，这可能会表现为一种挑战我们的东西。

sentences.en: That constant evolution is going to perhaps make our lives feel unstable.
sentences.zh: 这种持续的演变可能会让我们的生活感到不稳定。

sentences.en: An example of this that I was thinking about the other day was the invention and spread of AI technology and how many of us feel uncomfortable with it.
sentences.zh: 我前几天想到的一个例子是人工智能技术的发明和传播，以及我们中有多少人对此感到不舒服。

sentences.en: There's this fear of what that's going to do to our jobs, our way of interacting with one another and our way of interacting with the world.
sentences.zh: 人们担心这会对我们的工作、我们彼此互动的方式以及我们与世界互动的方式产生什么影响。

sentences.en: That is an example of change that feels rapidly quite uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 这是一个让人感到迅速且相当不舒服的变化的例子。

sentences.en: And it's definitely a big picture example.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是一个宏观的例子。

sentences.en: But when you think about it on a more micro scale in terms of your own life, something may be changing in your family, with your relationships, in your career,
sentences.zh: 但当你从更微观的角度思考你自己的生活时，你的家庭、人际关系、职业生涯中可能正在发生变化，

sentences.en: even your living situation maybe.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能是你的居住环境。

sentences.en: Whether it's a breakup or you're moving in with someone, there's a new friendship or a broken one.
sentences.zh: 无论是分手还是与人同居，一段新的友谊或一段破裂的友谊。

sentences.en: Life keeps presenting opportunities to grow that are hidden in these moments, even when they are challenging.
sentences.zh: 生活不断提供隐藏在这些时刻中的成长机会，即使它们充满挑战。

sentences.en: I guess what I'm trying to say is that embracing growth and change is key.
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，拥抱成长和变化是关键。

sentences.en: We need to stay flexible and resilient.
sentences.zh: 我们需要保持灵活和韧性。

sentences.en: And my favorite word here is resilience.
sentences.zh: 而我最喜欢的词就是：韧性。

sentences.en: Because when we are resilient, we understand that no matter what is coming into our life that feels unexpected, we can kind of see it in two ways.
sentences.zh: 因为当我们拥有韧性时，我们就会明白，无论生活中出现什么意想不到的事情，我们都可以从两个角度来看待它。

sentences.en: We can see it as something that is going to threaten us or we can see it as an opportunity instead of holding on to what is familiar just because it feels safe.
sentences.zh: 我们可以把它看作是一种威胁，或者我们可以把它看作是一个机会，而不是仅仅因为感到安全而紧紧抓住熟悉的事物不放。

sentences.en: I think about this especially in terms of relationships.
sentences.zh: 我特别是在人际关系方面思考这个问题。

sentences.en: Maybe it's with an ex, a friend, a former colleague, someone that you're just not as close to anymore who maybe doesn't make you feel great about yourself.
sentences.zh: 也许是与前任、朋友、前同事的关系，或者是某个你不再那么亲近的人，他们可能让你对自己感觉不太好。

sentences.en: You can hold on to that good but not great relationship because it's always been convenient because it's been something that you've known for a really long time
sentences.zh: 你可以坚持那段“还行但并不好”的关系，因为它一直很方便，因为它是你认识了很久的东西，

sentences.en: and because your brain has made you feel safe and secure and comfortable in that emotional environment.
sentences.zh: 而且因为你的大脑让你在那种情感环境中感到安全、稳妥和舒适。

sentences.en: But you could also move beyond that relationship.
sentences.zh: 但你也可以超越那段关系。

sentences.en: You could realize that you deserve great and that there is going to be some pain, some temporary discomfort, but these new experiences and the opportunities that you get
sentences.zh: 你可以意识到你值得拥有更好的，虽然会有一些痛苦，一些暂时的不适，但这些新的体验以及你通过为新的人腾出空间而获得的机会，

sentences.en: from making space for someone new is worth so much more.
sentences.zh: 其价值要高得多。

sentences.en: And I think this mindset changes the way that we deal with life.
sentences.zh: 我认为这种心态改变了我们处理生活的方式。

sentences.en: Being able to pivot, be resilient, be flexible when things shift, it doesn't just make you stronger mentally, emotionally, socially.
sentences.zh: 当事情发生变化时，能够转变、保持韧性、保持灵活，这不仅能让你在心理、情感和社交上变得更强大，

sentences.en: It also makes you happier as well.
sentences.zh: 它也会让你更快乐。

sentences.en: So let's talk about what all this means for us.
sentences.zh: 所以，让我们谈谈这一切对我们意味着什么。

sentences.en: And let's start with the emotional discomfort of change.
sentences.zh: 让我们从变化带来的情感不适开始。

sentences.en: One way that we can really adopt this mantra is by thinking about our best, most ideal self, the person we want to be in the long term, someone who perhaps has their dream life,
sentences.zh: 我们可以真正采纳这个咒语的一种方式是思考我们最好、最理想的自我，即我们长期以来想成为的那个人，那个可能拥有梦想生活的人，

sentences.en: has moved to a place of abundance, who is more authentic, who is more confident.
sentences.zh: 那个已经进入富足状态、更真实、更自信的人。

sentences.en: Really imagine that person for a moment.
sentences.zh: 真的想象一下那个人片刻。

sentences.en: Imagine that person that you're going to be in five years, in 10 years.
sentences.zh: 想象一下五年后、十年后的你。

sentences.en: What are they doing?
sentences.zh: 他们在做什么？

sentences.en: What does their day look like?
sentences.zh: 他们的一天是什么样的？

sentences.en: What are they wearing?
sentences.zh: 他们穿着什么？

sentences.en: What are the obstacles that they're now facing that they can handle even better because of what you're going through now?
sentences.zh: 他们现在面临的障碍是什么？因为你现在所经历的一切，他们是否能处理得更好？

sentences.en: Is that person going to be realized without change?
sentences.zh: 如果没有变化，那个人能实现吗？

sentences.en: Probably not.
sentences.zh: 可能不会。

sentences.en: Is that person going to come into existence without growth?
sentences.zh: 如果没有成长，那个人能存在吗？

sentences.en: No, definitely not.
sentences.zh: 不，绝对不会。

sentences.en: Because if that person was already to exist, you wouldn't be thinking about these things because it would already be in place.
sentences.zh: 因为如果那个人已经存在，你就不会考虑这些事情了，因为一切都已经就位了。

sentences.en: When adopting this week's mantra, I embrace growth and change.
sentences.zh: 在采纳本周的咒语“我拥抱成长与变化”时，

sentences.en: I want you to really think about how it's going to take you from where you are now into your future self.
sentences.zh: 我希望你真正思考它将如何把你从现在的状态带向未来的自我。

sentences.en: Just remember this.
sentences.zh: 记住这一点。

sentences.en: This is all about seeing change for what it is.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是为了看清变化的本质。

sentences.en: It is not an enemy.
sentences.zh: 它不是敌人。

sentences.en: It is actually something that helps us become the best version of ourselves.
sentences.zh: 它实际上是帮助我们成为最好的自己的东西。

sentences.en: Coming up, let's get personal.
sentences.zh: 接下来，让我们谈谈私人的事情。

sentences.en: I'm going to get real about how this mantra plays out in my life.
sentences.zh: 我将真实地讲述这个咒语在我的生活中是如何发挥作用的。

sentences.en: The ups, the downs, how I've navigated through it.
sentences.zh: 起起落落，以及我是如何度过这些难关的。

sentences.en: So stay tuned after this brief pause.
sentences.zh: 所以请在短暂休息后继续收听。

sentences.en: This is an iHeart PodcaSt.
sentences.zh: 这是一个iHeart播客。

sentences.en: Guaranteed human.
sentences.zh: 保证由人类制作。
